Read the story

“When you're running a clinical study at this scale, it's not just about the sample size. It's about managing complexity without sacrificing the science. SurveyMonkey allowed us to do both.”

Myles Johnson, Product Manager, Noom

Read the story
Our commitment to using AI responsibly

AI is great at helping people find patterns and move faster. But it can't tell you why customers or employees are frustrated, excited, or ready for change. Those answers come from people.

For more than 25 years, SurveyMonkey has helped organizations collect feedback, understand it, and act on it with confidence. We use AI to make that process faster and easier to understand, while keeping trust, privacy, and real human perspectives at the center.

Meera Vaidyanathan, Chief Product Officer
